module.label: Spotify overlay
module.description: Shows the current Spotify song and spectrum.

flows.label: Spotify changes song
flows.detail: The existing Windows observer detects native Spotify starts/resumes and aborts registered background music through public source-owner APIs once per transport start. Song owners also cancel random mode and pending requests. Pausing Spotify never resumes an aborted Hub song. A newer Hub music selection pauses native Spotify before its source starts; no reciprocal coordinator pause claim or extra worker is added.

steps.label: Observe Spotify media session
steps.detail: WinRT play/pause and metadata events wake the existing media loop promptly. Track properties are reused until a metadata event or session replacement, with a five-second fallback for missed events. The half-second playback heartbeat preserves freshness without rereading track properties. A revision captured before an awaited read preserves intervening metadata changes; current playback status is read afterward. Old subscriptions are removed on session replacement or shutdown.

steps.detail: One owned process captures only Spotify on an MTA thread and serves fresh spectra directly on the existing browser port. Hub status is sampled from a nonblocking latest-frame mailbox; a separate control mailbox carries media and visibility. Process identity checks replace global scans. Causal frequency windows and bounded cleanup preserve one capture. Fixed waveform gain and unsaturated full-window presence preserve loud/quiet contrast. Salient partial interactions supply a bounded roughness proxy; spectral flatness supplies noise content. Both reuse the existing transform and are published in complete audio frames. Absolute register energy uses Hann-compensated Parseval power from the same causal transforms. Display compression never supplies structural gain. Frequency selections and waveform coordinates are cached in bounded immutable plans; stereo register power is reduced in batches without changing per-packet cadence or measured values. Float PCM capture retains quiet playback detail. AudioLevel applies one bounded visual-only gain before assembling causal windows and nonlinear DSP. A held RMS reference cancels constant playback-volume differences; a thirty-second release preserves brief musical dips and readjusts sustained level reductions gradually. Silence freezes the reference and remains quiet. Reconnecting capture resets the reference. No Spotify, Windows or OBS volume is changed. Held-partial contrast, causal spectral novelty and upper-register energy reuse that same transform. One bounded spectral envelope follows actual capture-packet duration; four additional scalars travel in each complete fixed mailbox frame.

flows.label: An audible clip interrupts Spotify
flows.detail: New Hub songs and mood music explicitly request music focus: native Spotify must pause before source startup; failed music admission prevents overlapping playback. A newer song can reclaim focus after a user Spotify resume. Native Spotify starts/resumes abort registered background music and random playback through public revert contracts, once per transport start. Ordinary clip claims retain reference counting, cancelled/expired admission, same-session/track restoration and user-change revocation. Leases release after source cleanup; no additional worker or timer is added.
